title: Diwali Lakshmi Ganesh Puja

hook: Shubh Diwali! Maa Lakshmi ka darshan

scenes.prompt: Close-up portrait of Maa Lakshmi with golden-pink skin and a serene smile, seated on a pink lotus, wearing a red and gold saree and a gold crown, face in the middle of the frame, rows of glowing diyas around her, warm Diwali light
scenes.tts: शुभ दिवाली! माँ लक्ष्मी का दर्शन कीजिए।
scenes.sub: Shubh Diwali! Maa Lakshmi ka darshan kijiye.

scenes.prompt: An Indian home being cleaned and decorated before Diwali, a woman sweeping the doorstep, marigold garlands on the door, clay diyas arranged in a row, warm afternoon light
scenes.tts: दिवाली पर घर की सफ़ाई और सजावट की परंपरा है।
scenes.sub: Diwali par ghar ki safai aur sajawat ki parampara hai.

scenes.prompt: A family seated together on the floor before a small puja altar at dusk, a brass thali with diyas, flowers and sweets, pictures of Maa Lakshmi and Ganesh ji, warm glowing light, peaceful faces
scenes.tts: शाम को परिवार साथ बैठकर लक्ष्मी-गणेश की पूजा करता है।
scenes.sub: Shaam ko parivar saath baithkar Lakshmi-Ganesh ki puja karta hai.
scenes.animate: the diya flames flicker gently and thin incense smoke curls slowly upward

scenes.prompt: Close-up portrait of elephant-headed Lord Ganesh ji with orange-red skin, a golden crown, one tusk, a gentle smile, face in the middle of the frame, glowing diyas and marigold flowers around him
scenes.tts: मान्यता है कि हर शुभ काम गणेश जी से शुरू होता है।
scenes.sub: Manyata hai ki har shubh kaam Ganesh ji se shuru hota hai.
scenes.animate: a very slow gentle camera push-in, the face stays still and serene, the soft golden glow gently pulses, a few petals drift in the background

scenes.prompt: A woman placing a lit clay diya on the doorstep of her home at twilight, rows of diyas glowing along the steps and windows, marigold garland on the door, warm festive night
scenes.tts: द्वार पर दीपक जलाकर माँ लक्ष्मी का स्वागत किया जाता है।
scenes.sub: Dwar par deepak jalakar Maa Lakshmi ka swagat kiya jaata hai.

scenes.prompt: Maa Lakshmi with golden-pink skin seated on a pink lotus with Lord Ganesh ji with orange-red skin beside her, both blessing with raised palms, glowing diyas and lotus petals around them, golden light
scenes.tts: यह दीपों का पर्व सबके जीवन में प्रकाश और सुख लाए।
scenes.sub: Yeh deepon ka parv sabke jeevan mein prakash aur sukh laye.
scenes.animate: a very slow gentle camera push-in, the faces stay still and serene, the diya flames flicker softly, a few petals drift in the background

scenes.tts: ॐ महालक्ष्म्यै नमः। लाइक, शेयर, सब्सक्राइब करें। कल गोवर्धन पूजा। जय माँ लक्ष्मी!
scenes.sub: Om Mahalakshmyai Namah. Like, Share, Subscribe karein. Kal Govardhan Puja. Jai Maa Lakshmi!
